source.author: cic
source.text: sapienter fecisse dicitur, cum de eo nihil sanxerit quod antea commissum non erat, ne non tam prohibere quam admonere videretur.
source.text_original: sapienter fecisse dicitur, cum de eo nihil sanxerit quod antea commissum non erat, ne non tam prohibere quam admonere videretur.
source.text_english: It is said that he acted wisely in that he decreed nothing about this matter that had not previously been entrusted to him, lest he seem not so much to forbid as merely to give warning.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: intellegis, quid loquar dabit enim tibi deus in omnibus intellectum nec statim aduersum saeuissimam heresim et multo his nequiora, quam dixi, responsionem flagitabis, ne non tam prohibuisse uidear quam commonuisse, cum praesentis operis sit instruere uirginem, non hereticis respondere.
reuse.text_original: intellegis, quid loquar — dabit enim tibi deus in omnibus intellectum — nec statim aduersum saeuissimam heresim et multo his nequiora, quam dixi, responsionem flagitabis, ne non tam prohibuisse uidear quam commonuisse, cum praesentis operis sit instruere uirginem, non hereticis respondere.
reuse.text_english: You understand what I am saying. For God will give you understanding in all things. Nor will you immediately demand an answer against the most savage heresy and the far worse things that I have mentioned, lest I seem not so much to have forbidden them as merely warned against them, since the purpose of the present work is to instruct a virgin, not to პასუხ to heretics.
